x: Veerapurushadatta was the Ikshvaku king who rebuilt the Nagarjunakonda Maha Chaitya and Sriparvata University; Vikramashila was a Pala (Dharmapala) Vajrayana centre, so A is the wrong pair. Naganika - Naneghat and Gautami Balashri - Nasik cave are correct, and the Sanchi toranas are a Satavahana gift (the notes credit the south torana to Siri Satakarni).

Gosala spent about six years as Mahavira's companion before breaking away to lead the Ajivikas. Jain texts make Gosala Mahavira's disciple (some notes call him Mahavira's 'guru'), but never Mahavira a disciple of Gosala, and they did not stay in one order.
